title: Valetudinarian
summary: VALETUDINA'RIAN, VALETU'DINARY, adjective [Latin valetudinarius, from valetudo, from valeo, to be well.] Sickly; weak; infirm; seeking to recover health. VALETUDINA'RIAN, VALETU'DINARY, noun A person

inlines.v: VALETUDINA'RIAN, VALETU'DINARY, adjective [Latin valetudinarius, from valetudo, from valeo, to be well.] Sickly; weak; infirm; seeking to recover health. VALETUDINA'RIAN, VALETU'DINARY, noun A person of a weak, infirm or sickly constitution; one who is seeking to recover health. Valetudinarians must live where they can command and scold.
